method.identity: Compare blind all-phone output B/P order with published full CREMA-D phrase classes. Known transcript is a ceiling and cannot establish blind identity.
method.anchors: GRID publisher initial B/P word windows only. A first-difference impulse peak and independent positive log-spectral flux peak must agree within 15 ms. Both must stand out from competing peaks. These are signal landmarks with 25 ms uncertainty, without manual phoneme-release truth.
method.raw_comparator: Frozen high-pass untyped transients from the preceding single-file evaluation.
method.timed_comparators: Known-transcript and blind allphone B/P interval ends within 50 ms of the presealed raw landmark. Interval ends are model coordinates, not independently established releases.
method.scope: Verify native PTS and canonical PCM. For an existing audio-only shift copy, only map a source anchor if the full uncertainty slice is exactly copied and both video clocks still agree.

interpretation: Lexical references give expected phone identity. Signal-derived landmarks carry stated uncertainty and no manual phoneme release truth. Shift sensitivity is unavailable because no complete independently derived landmark was copied. No AI confidence weight or serving change.
